es-cafe-listen-audio.role: listen stimulus of the Phase 3.1 café listen pilot
es-cafe-listen-audio.transcript: Un café, por favor. ¿Para tomar aquí o para llevar? Para tomar aquí, gracias.
es-cafe-listen-audio.note: Empty sha256 by design: no audio file is shipped. The on-device course voice reads the transcript at lesson time; the first reviewed recording that ships must fill in the real file hash (and then be removed from tools/device-speech-media.txt).

es-cafe-listen-model.role: self-compare model reading for the pilot's respond step
es-cafe-listen-model.note: Same empty-sha256 policy as es-cafe-listen-audio: on-device synthesis, no shipped file.

sequence: es-cafe-listen — listen (es-cafe-mission-step-10, information on the audio stimulus) → interpret (es-cafe-mission-step-11/12/13, three selection steps bound to the stimulus: gist, order detail, here-vs-take-away detail) → respond (es-cafe-mission-step-14, self-compare with modelAudioId es-cafe-listen-model). The steps sit between the existing matching step (step-8) and the final-response text step (step-9); step-9 remains the lesson terminal.
delivery: device-speech — intentionally NOT shipped as a recording. At lesson time AudioStimulusView (Condisco/Lesson/StimulusViews.swift, synthesizedAlternative) reads the declared transcript with the on-device synthesized course voice (AVSpeechSynthesizer via ShadowSpeaker / ShadowVoice, language es-ES); see tools/device-speech-media.txt allowlist entries es-cafe-listen-audio / es-cafe-listen-model.

generator.voice: the learner's chosen Spanish course voice if set (VoiceStore), otherwise any installed es-* voice; rate 0.92 × default (see ShadowMode.swift)
generator.note: Not a fixed file voice: output varies by device and voice selection, so no static audio hash exists.

method: authored transcript rendered by device TTS at runtime
generatedDate: n/a — rendered on demand on the learner's device
source: authored content — original lesson text written for the es-cafe-mission listen sequence; no external recording, no template, no copied audio
sources: Condisco/Content/packs/spanish.json — media entries "es-cafe-listen-audio" and "es-cafe-listen-model": "Authored lesson text; no recording shipped — on-device course voice reads the transcript at lesson time; see docs/audio-provenance/spanish-cafe-listen-pilot.json. Naturalness of the on-device Spanish voice unverified (reviewPending: true)."

Condisco/Content/packs/spanish.json — stimulus "es-cafe-listen-stim" (kind audio) binds es-cafe-listen-audio; selection activities es-cafe-listen-gist / es-cafe-listen-drink / es-cafe-listen-here bind the stimulus; self-compare activity es-cafe-listen-say binds es-cafe-listen-model via modelAudioId
tools/device-speech-media.txt — allowlist entries "es-cafe-listen-audio" and "es-cafe-listen-model" (declared media ids with no shipped file, reported as device-speech intentional)
Condisco/Lesson/StimulusViews.swift — AudioStimulusView shows "Course voice (synthesized)" and reads the transcript via ShadowSpeaker when the declared url does not resolve in the bundle
Condisco/Listen/ShadowMode.swift — ShadowVoice.languageCode(for: "spanish") = "es-ES"; ShadowSpeaker renders utterances with AVSpeechSynthesizer
unknownFacts: naturalness/prosody of the on-device Spanish voice for these two transcripts: unverified — reviewPending: true until a human listens on-device (see the Phase 3.1 iPhone check list)
final on-device voice: depends on each learner's device and VoiceStore selection; there is no single recorded rendering to attest
